descriptions: Learned the craft the hard way and never looked back.
Walks the line between discipline and instinct.
Trained for years, then went out to find a real test.
Fights for coin, for honor or for both.
Relies on a lifetime of habit to survive.
Knows the dangers of the road better than any map.
Calm in a crisis and dangerous in a corner.
Follows an old tradition few still remember.
Always prepared, rarely surprised.
A specialist others are glad to have on their side.
Mixes patience and sudden violence.
Carries the lessons of a mentor long gone.
Rarely seen, often felt.
Believes the right tool is skill, not luck.
Chose this path, and the path chose back.
Heir to a craft passed from hand to hand.
Never the loudest in the room, always the last standing.
Lives by a code that few understand.
Cuts through chaos with practiced calm.
A reliable pillar of any party.
